from pathlib import Path
import json
p=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4/code/control/jobs/full_a2z_model_stage.py'
txt=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') if p.is_file() else ''
keys=('PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT','retry_at','attempt','resume','WORKER_START','TEMPFAIL','SystemExit','return 75','raise SystemExit(75)')
lines=txt.splitlines()
hits=[]
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if any(k in line for k in keys):
        a=max(1,i-3); b=min(len(lines),i+5)
        hits.append({'line':i,'context':[[n,lines[n-1]] for n in range(a,b+1)]})
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_RUNTIME_RESUME_LOGIC',flush=True)
print('ERROR='+json.dumps(hits,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
